Looting
is the main source for acquiring items, gear and weapons in the rust belt and are often needed for
Quests
,
Workshop Upgrades
, Crafting or can be sold or recycled to break them down into smaller resources. Recycling items during a raid only returns 50% of the usual components.
Use the categorized tables below to prioritize what to take and what to leave behind.
You can recycle almost every item for materials, but  recycling can only be done while in Speranza.
Salvaging yields fewer or lower-quality items than recycling, but can be done while Topside.

Weapon Attachments
Weapon Modifications
are items you can throw onto your weapons in and out of raid that provide upgrades to you weapons.
Craft them at the Gunsmith in your
workshop
, find them in raid, or buy some basic modifications from
Tian Wen
.
Check each weapon's individual page to see which modifications slots are available and compatible.
Ammo
Ammo
for weapons can be found scattered around the map. You can also find ammunition on knocked out raiders and destroyed
ARC
.
*Weapon sell price is now tied to remaining durability and upgrade tier.

Equipment plays a vital role in your survival and combat while topside. From increasing your carrying capacity to defending against
ARC
and other raiders, every piece of gear is crucial in your loadout.
Augments
Augments
are used by your raider to primarily increase carry space, weight capacity, and
shield
compatibility. Some augments have additional perks. Augments cannot be adjusted while Topside.
Some Augments increase
Quick Use
slots at the cost of Weight Capacity.
Shields
Shields
are used by Raiders to negate incoming damage while Topside. Some shields reduce mobility for the upside of increased protection.
Augments
are needed to wear the higher end shields.
Healing
Healing
items are used by all Raiders to survive while Topside. Some healing items focus on health, some recharging shield, and others stamina.
Quick Use
You have 2 different types of
Quick Use
items, Utility and Gadgets. Both types try solve any possible problems you'll run into while Topside, be it from other Raiders or
ARC
.
Grenades
Grenades
have lots of different functions that are used by Raiders to accomplish all sorts of tasks. In a pinch some
ARC
parts or scavenged loot can be thrown and used as makeshift grenades.
Traps
Traps
come in 2 varieties, Laser traps and Mines. Both can be very effective against
ARC
or Raiders. With the
Minesweeper skill
Raiders can defuse other's traps.

rows: Building the base structure and frame of the caravan
Connecting wiring, ventilation, and essential power systems
Building walls and roof, installing, core systems, and defining the interior layout
Adding storage, workbenches, utilities, and personal touches
Loading the caravan with vital supplies. Combat gear, survival equipment, provisions, and repair materials are needed to fully prepare for the Expedition.

Your caravan is stocked with necessities and ready to depart on your Expedition. Once the departure window opens, you can choose to send your Raider beyond the borders of the Rust Belt forever. All items remaining in your Raider's stash will be contributed to the Expedition, and your next Raider can earn up to five skill points based on on the total value of those items.

Blueprints
Blueprints
are a core component of the Workshop system. They are used to craft specific items such as weapons, materials, and gadgets.
Blueprints are most reliably found in the loot containers of locked rooms, but can occasionally be rewards from quests.
A
blueprint must be extracted before it can be used
.
Place it in your Safe Pocket to guarantee you'll be able to learn it. Once returned to Speranza, consuming the blueprint will add it to the relevant workshop station.
